title: Regret-Minimising Bet Review
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bet:personal
| stats sum(stake) as total_stake, avg(regret_score) as avg_regret by bet_type
| sort - avg_regret
description: Compares personal bets by their average regret score so you can see which styles of wager feel worst in hindsight.
value: A bet can be profitable on paper and still be strategically bad if it creates repeated regret or misalignment.
implementation: Capture a post-resolution regret score on `bet:personal` events and average it by bet type.
visualization: Table of bet types by average regret score.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which kinds of bets you most often wish you had not made afterward.
